description: MainActivity.kt is the main entry point of the Smart Home TV app. It manages the primary UI components including a persistent sidebar with navigation icons (Dashboard, Activity, Settings) and a content area that loads corresponding fragments. It handles focus navigation suitable for TV remote control, visual focus states, and fragment transactions to display different screens.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The primary activity for the Smart Home TV app, managing navigation bar, content fragments, and focus states.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up the sidebar navigation, and loads the default dashboard section.

methods.name: roundedFocusBackground
methods.description: Creates a rounded drawable with a stroke for focus indication on navigation icons.

methods.name: setupSidebar
methods.description: Configures the focus, click listeners, and visual states for sidebar icons.

methods.name: showSection
methods.description: Switches the displayed fragment to the selected section and shows a toast message.
